**Synthetic Scout (Occupation)**

**Prerequisite:** Age 10+.

**Skills:** Select any two skills from the following list as permanent class skills: Balance, Gather Information, Knowledge (tactics), Treat Injury.

**Feat:** Select one of the following: Alertness, Nin Weapons Proficiency.

**Wealth Bonus Increase:** +1

**Reputation Bonus Increase:** +1
